DLC2311:4:t_001:5.en:
Spectator
「Though after today, we probably won't see you alive at all!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:6.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Those bastards! They can say whatever they like, huh?!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:7.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Leave it, $$ココナ$$! There's no point dealing with trash like that!」

DLC2311:4:t_001:8.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Now all we can do is put our faith in him!」

DLC2311:4:t_002:0.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Wait, $$キリコ$$. We're not the only ones in this Battling match.」

DLC2311:4:t_003:0.en:
$$桂$$
「A little late, but $$桂木桂$$ has arrived.」

DLC2311:4:t_003:2.en:
$$桂$$
「A $$レッドショルダー$$ winning every Battling match... I had a hunch, and sure enough, it was you, $$キリコ$$.」

DLC2311:4:t_003:3.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キリコ$$... It seems $$桂$$'s won too often, too, and now they want him dead.」

DLC2311:4:t_003:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I came here determined to win no matter who I faced, but first, we have to deal with this.」

DLC2311:4:t_003:6.en:
$$桂$$
「A temporary truce, $$キリコ$$! Let's take them out first!」

DLC2311:4:t_003:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Wait, $$桂$$. What do you mean, temporary...?」

DLC2311:4:t_003:8.en:
$$桂$$
「Exactly what I said. I have a reason I absolutely have to win this battle.」

DLC2311:4:t_004:0.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Looks like $$桂$$ and $$キリコ$$ have teamed up!」

DLC2311:4:t_004:1.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Then we're safe! $$桂$$ may be a womanizer, but his skills are the real deal!」

DLC2311:4:t_004:3.en:
$$ココナ$$
「What?! You got a problem with that?!」

DLC2311:4:t_004:4.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「No matter how much they hate $$桂$$ and $$キリコ$$, that many AT pilots joining forces is hard to believe.」

DLC2311:4:t_004:5.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「And never mind their machines. Their weapons are all shiny, brand-new factory models.」

DLC2311:4:t_004:6.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Probably backed by the matchmakers who lost money because of $$キリコ$$.」

DLC2311:4:t_004:7.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「That's not all I'm worried about. If those rumors about $$桂$$ are true...」

DLC2311:4:t_004:8.en:
$$ココナ$$
「We can talk later! It's starting!」

DLC2311:4:t_004:10.en:
$$桂$$
「Don't worry, $$モーム$$. I will win.」

DLC2311:4:t_004:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Even if my opponent is $$キリコ$$, I'm going to win this battle!」

DLC2311:4:t_005:0.en:
Spectator
「N-no way! Just three of them took down that many?!」

DLC2311:4:t_005:1.en:
Spectator
「What are those of us who bet on them losing supposed to do?!」

DLC2311:4:t_005:2.en:
Spectator
「I-I'm ruined! Those bastards shot down our lives, too!」

DLC2311:4:t_005:3.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Shut up! You've only got yourselves to blame!」

DLC2311:4:t_006:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Stop, $$桂$$. Are you really going to fight $$キリコ$$?」

DLC2311:4:t_006:2.en:
$$桂$$
「I've got a reason I can't back down, too.」

DLC2311:4:t_006:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Besides, it'll be better for $$キリコ$$ this way.」

DLC2311:4:t_006:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Right now, $$キリコ$$'s an empty shell. If that's how it is, putting him out of his misery is friendship, too.」

DLC2311:4:t_007:0.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「Martial might brings harmony to all things...」

DLC2311:4:t_007:2.en:
$$防衛隊員$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$, the $$触れ得ざる者$$... You are our enemy.」

DLC2311:4:t_007:3.en:
$$桂$$
「That mantra, and those ATs...! $$マーティアル$$!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:4.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Now it all makes sense! They were behind this battle royal!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:5.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Those $$マーティアル$$ bastards! They'd go this far just because they hate $$キリコ$$?!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:8.en:
$$桂$$
「You're the ones who hounded $$キリコ$$ and robbed him of his time with $$フィアナ$$!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:9.en:
$$桂$$
「And now you resent him for fighting back?! You couldn't be more in the wrong!!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$モーム$$. I just can't forgive them... So...」

DLC2311:4:t_007:12.en:
$$モーム$$
「Neither can I, Master $$桂$$! Please... take those people down!」

DLC2311:4:t_007:15.en:
$$桂$$
「Leave it to me. $c's aces of land and sky are together. Like hell we'd lose to them!」

DLC2311:4:t_008:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... Now we've beaten the masterminds, we can get back to our Battling match with nothing hanging over us.」

DLC2311:4:t_009:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$キリコ$$. I need money to fix $$モーム$$'s body. No matter what.」

DLC2311:4:t_009:3.en:
$$桂$$
「$$モーム$$'s an android... And she was built in another world. Even when something's wrong, repairing her isn't easy.」

DLC2311:4:t_009:6.en:
$$モーム$$
「Please stop, Master $$桂$$! I'm all right...」

DLC2311:4:t_009:7.en:
$$桂$$
「I can't, $$モーム$$. The fight doesn't end until there's a winner.」

DLC2311:4:t_009:8.en:
$$桂$$
「Besides, unlike $$キリコ$$, who's just drifting from fight to fight, I've got a reason I have to win.」

DLC2311:4:t_009:10.en:
$$桂$$
「We'll settle this with one shot. Here I come.」

DLC2311:4:t_010:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It's all right, $$モーム$$. $$キリコ$$ the immortal has already ejected.」

DLC2311:4:t_010:3.en:
$$モーム$$
「Did he lose on purpose for my sake?」

DLC2311:4:t_010:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「Don't tell me... He was trying to die...?」

DLC2311:4:t_010:6.en:
$$桂$$
「A few minutes ago, he might have been.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:0.en:
$$桂$$
「But he remembered what it means to live. So he probably ended his unbeaten streak himself to put Battling behind him.」

DLC2311:4:t_011:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「And knowing that, you deliberately provoked $$キリコ$$... then aimed away from the cockpit...」

review.context: Kei joins Chirico and Shako against a rigged battle royal. Martial agents reveal themselves; Kei's anger and Mome's condition help Chirico recover a reason to live.
decisions: Kei's put-him-out-of-his-misery threat is deliberate provocation, later explained by his nonfatal shot.
Mome asks whether Chirico intentionally lost for her, and Kei confirms; she does not accuse Kei of throwing the match.
